# Tasks prompt

Use this prompt to generate individual task files under `.specify/tasks/`.

Context:

- Provide a link to the plan phase and the specific deliverable.
- Include acceptance criteria and a small checklist.
- Indicate required files and tests to accompany the change.

Template:

- Task title
- Description
- Acceptance Criteria (3–5 bullet points)
- Estimated effort (S/M/L)
- Owner
